name: StalkChain Data
tagline: Research crypto traders, wallets, and on-chain activity.
description: Query tracked trader wallets, positions, and PnL, token holders and buy/sell flow, and on-chain research data. This hosted endpoint requires sign-in to a StalkChain Data account via OAuth. Metered tools use account credits. The directory endpoint excludes trading and fund movement.

install.notes: Approve the StalkChain OAuth sign-in in your browser. See https://data.stalkchain.com/docs/guides/getting-started for account and setup details.
